name: Codex
description: Brain on a ChatGPT subscription: runs the Codex CLI (codex exec) with Piomio tools.
settings.command.title: CLI command
settings.command.description: Left as “codex”, the hub runs the newest Codex on this computer: the one in PATH or the copy the ChatGPT app carries. Newer Codex versions get newer models.
settings.apiKeyRef.title: OpenAI key (vault reference, optional)
settings.apiKeyRef.description: If empty, the ChatGPT subscription is used: sign in from the chat.
settings.sandbox.title: Codex sandbox
settings.sandbox.description: On a Mac the hub keeps commands inside the agent's folder (workspace-write, no network) and asks you for the rest; read-only is stricter still.
